settings.question: How often is New In updated?
settings.answer: New lines are added every week, across all departments. Sort by newest to see the most recent additions first.

settings.question: Are new products available in store as well as online?
settings.answer: Most are, but stock arrives in stores at different times. If you want to be sure, call your local store before travelling, or reserve with Click & Collect.

settings.question: Can I get pharmacist advice on a new product?
settings.answer: Yes. Contact our pharmacy team for help choosing a product, checking interactions with anything you already take, or deciding whether to see your GP.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: We aim to ship all items within the same working day for orders placed before 3pm, Monday to Friday. Delivery is free on orders over [threshold], and Click & Collect is available at all seven of our stores.
